text: The Patriots limp into Week 4 facing the Bills at Highmark Stadium on Sunday at 1 PM ET with their offense in full crisis mode—dead last in the NFL at 9.7 points per game—after a humbling 35-6 dismantling in Jacksonville where Drake Maye coughed up three turnovers (two interceptions and a lost fumble) and subsequently called his own performance and the entire offensive unit "unacceptable." Film breakdowns have raised questions about whether the Patriots are even deploying Maye correctly in the first place, and while the young quarterback is clearly looking inward for answers, the offensive scheme, supporting cast, and execution all appear fundamentally broken heading into a divisional matchup that offers no mercy whatsoever.
